newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley names new Van Kampen chiefs.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley names new Van Kampen chiefs.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Group Inc said Tuesday that it has named Don Powell as chairman of Van Kampen American Capital Inc and selected Philip Duff as president and chief executive of the division.
Duff is chief financial officer of Morgan Stanley Group Inc and will remain in the job until a successor is found, the company said.
Duff succeeds Powell as president and chief executive, and Powell's position of chairman was newly created, said Morgan Stanley spokesman John Diat.
Morgan Stanley finalized its acquisition of Van Kampen, the country's fourth largest non-proprietary mutual fund provider, late last year.
